messages:
tia-csm: Hi team — Parallax Health onboarding check. They hit token peaks in APAC staging, asking for a temporary QPS bump + IP allowlist for our APAC proxy. Also asked if we can pre-warm KV cache for their demo cadence (bursts every 10s). Renewal nudges here (trial ends in 14 days).
parallax-support: thanks, tia. can you do a soft increase for 48h? peak seen around 09:00 SGT. CIDRs below — will add details when you confirm. also, we need an ssh tunnel to their on-prem analytics for logs (port 22022) during the demo window.
jordan-eng: ack. we can do a temp qps lift and add CIDRs to the allowlist. KV cache warmup — we can run a scripted prefix warm for their typical prompt set; will need the prompt hashes and approximate seq len distribution. can parallax share sample trace?
parallax-support: attaching sample traces in the ticket, but here's a quick summary: median seq len ~96 tokens, tail to 1024 for a tiny fraction. burst profile: 6 reqs over 30s, repeated.
ops-elia: netops note — we need the exact CIDR blocks (one /24 preferred) and intended duration. For proxy peering we'll add entries to ip-allowlist service and create a temporary egress rule. SSH tunnel: we'll coordinate with security to approve L7 NAT mapping for 22022.
parallax-support: OK: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.128/25. Request window: 2026-04-05T02:00Z to 2026-04-07T02:00Z (48h). Revoke at end automatically if not extended.
jordan-eng: sounds good. plan:
1) create allowlist entries in apac-proxy (203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.128/25)
2) bump QPS from 20 -> 80 for the customer account in APAC region, for the time window
3) run KV cache warm job to push top-10 prefixes, targets: prompt hashes provided
4) enable detailed logging and trace id tagging for the demo

ops-elia: I'll run the allowlist and QPS change. netops-bot — please schedule the auto-revoke job.
netops-bot: @ops-elia acknowledged. auto-revoke job created: job_id=job-PA-330111. Revoke scheduled at 2026-04-07T02:05Z.
deploy-bot: Deploy requested by jordan-eng: 
```
# apac temp config
account: parallax-health
region: apac-sg
qps: 80
allowlist: [203.0.113.0/24,198.51.100.128/25]
duration: 48h
```
ops-elia: running change now. will post confirmation and staged rollback plan.
ops-elia: CHANGE DONE — allowlist entries created and QPS bumped. KV cache warm job queued on the warmup queue (job id warm-330111). Please validate with Parallax. :white_check_mark:
parallax-support: confirming — seeing reduced 429s, initial latency slightly higher during warm, good otherwise. huge help.
tia-csm: great. I'll log renewal touchpoint and send enablement note with best-practices (batching, prefix caching). follow-up action: ensure auto-revoke triggers and capture demo feedback in the renewal playbook. :memo:
jordan-eng: note — we'll monitor KV cache hit ratio and revoke early if any regressions. set alert if 429s > 1% over 5m.
parallax-support: will share post-demo telemetry. thanks everyone! :pray:
